column2: [intro]
In life, don't sweat the small stuff,
Even if everything goes wrong, it's not that rough,
We can fail, we can miss the mark,
But what matters is laughing until we spark!
It's okay if it's a flop,
We have fun, we make bubbles pop,
In this crazy world we see,
We dance and just let it be!
All these little troubles, it's not the end,
We won't get worked up over a little bend,
Keep smiling, stay in cheer,
And let’s just laugh, it’s much clearer!
It's okay if it's a flop,
The key is to feel on top,
Tonight we party, let’s cheer,
And what counts is laughter, my dear!
[ solo ]
It's okay if it's a flop,
We have fun, we make bubbles pop,
In this crazy world we see,
We dance and just let it be!
[outro]
